# Hallmark — when to use (summary)

Upstream: https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark

**Use for:** greenfield standalone marketing/portfolio HTML pages; `audit` / `redesign` / `study` verbs.

**Do not use as primary for:** React/Vue design-system apps where output must be your components; locked brand systems that conflict with catalog themes.

Verbs: build (default) · `hallmark audit` · `hallmark redesign` · `hallmark study`.

Install: `npx skills add nutlope/hallmark`
